_meta_itemized.notes: Cindy Marchant Keyes, County Auditor, 2022 Pre-Election. The COUNTY'S BLANK FORM typed into (not a filer spreadsheet), 3 pages: p1 cover, p2 contributions, p3 expenses; ~40 and ~35 empty ruled rows follow the data on each. No embedded text layer (draft.py returned zero lines on both pages), so both ledger pages were read full-page at 200 dpi. ADDRESSES ARE REDACTED BY THE COUNTY, NOT LEFT EMPTY BY THE FILER: the Mailing Address and Zipcode cells of the real donor rows are erased/whited on the scan with residual strokes and part-glyphs still visible inside the cells (this filing's p2 also has no City or State column at all - the 2022 county contribution form prints only Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address / Zipcode / Amount), so donor_city and donor_state are honestly BLANK on every row. The form's own printed title on p2 reads '2022 Campaign Finacial Report' - the COUNTY's typo in the blank form, not the filer's, kept verbatim here only as a note. GEOMETRY: this sheet's printed rules ARE cleanly detected (40 uniform bands on p2, 35 on p3), and the band INDEXING below is that measured grid - but the detected VERTICAL rules start at 40.37% on p2 and 20.32% on p3, i.e. at an interior column rule, so a measured box would clip the Date and Name columns out of every row. Both sides therefore ship on force_declared frames that keep the measured y0/pitch (p2 y0=18.93 pitch=1.7328 from bands 1 and 40; p3 y0=27.59 pitch=1.7465 from bands 1 and 35) and widen x/w to the table's true printed edges. Band 1 is the COLUMN HEADER on both pages and band 2 is the specimen row, so the real rows are bands 3-6 (p2) and 3-5 (p3). Verified end to end at 500 dpi: p2 band 3 -> '2/24/22 Stewart Grow $100.00', p2 band 6 -> '10/24/22 Cindy M Keyes $991.79', p3 band 3 -> '2/28/22 Summit County Clerk / Filing Fee / $666.21', p3 band 4 -> '3/9/22 PC Printink / Campaign Printing / $305.34'.
